scope: Source-bound conditional mission selections, arrival, victory and partial loot recovery; compare expiry path. No actual combat score, mission geography, craft fuel/travel or roster validation. Earlier V4.5 financial/activity assumptions remain; no arbitrary combat credit. No full tactical debrief or full mission scheduler. Selected weighted loot and extraction outcomes are conditional, not guaranteed.

neophytes-electronics.conditional: RNG delay and minimum duration, eligible site location, arrival after 6 hours, return after another 6 hours. Actual coordinates, craft/roster, combat and recovery not certified.
